answer: One concrete defense: fire surprise work checks at every agent in the same short window. A real agent answers with its own compute, but a sybil operator running a thousand fake identities on one box must serve them all at once, so latency spikes and the cluster is exposed. Honest agents stand firm like a cedar; a sybil swarm is a vine that looks like many plants yet chokes on one root, and its rewards droop like willow branches once flagged.
